{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Among patients in the TREATMENT arm only, calculate the fraction who responded
treatment_data = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']
total_treatment = len(treatment_data)
responded_treatment = treatment_data['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = responded_treatment / total_treatment

fraction_responded"}
